key.name: pad-list-width
key.description: Stores the width of the pad list

key.name: window-width
key.description: Stores the width of the window

key.name: window-height
key.description: Stores the height of the width

key.name: cloud-last-backup-id
key.description: The newest Cloud Backup this device has seen, used to notice a replayed older backup

key.name: cloud-last-backup-updated-at
key.description: When the newest Cloud Backup this device has seen was made (Unix seconds)

key.name: cloud-sync-enabled
key.description: Keep the pads on this device in step with the Cloud Backup

key.name: cloud-sync-dirty
key.description: Local changes have been made that the Cloud Backup has not seen
